# Eatwith

> Eatwith connects travelers with local chefs and hosts worldwide for immersive culinary experiences including cooking classes, food tours, and private dining events.

Eatwith is a platform that democratizes food tourism by enabling authentic dining experiences with local hosts across major cities globally. The platform offers curated culinary experiences ranging from hands-on cooking classes to guided food tours and intimate supper clubs, with a strong presence in European destinations like Paris, Rome, Barcelona, and Amsterdam, as well as major cities including New York and Tokyo.
